name: VISUAL-DESIGN-QA
purpose: Prevent technically correct but visually poor releases
check: alignment, spacing, typography, contrast, component consistency, visual hierarchy, CTA prominence, layout density, overflow, responsive breakpoints, empty/error/loading states
evidence: screenshots or equivalent visual evidence when available
fail_criteria: A page that works but looks unfinished must FAIL visual QA
description: Visual design QA skill that ensures releases meet visual quality standards across all device sizes. Visual quality is a requirement, not an afterthought.
